form.label: CoolaShaker - Operations Hub
form.description: Welcome to CoolaShaker Multi-Site Operations Monitoring

div.p: Demo developed by Alexander Sötz · Questions or feedback? Contact me at asotz@cisco.com

search.query: index=demo_mes production_rate_per_hour=* | stats avg(oee_pct) as oee | eval oee=round(oee, 1) | eval range=case(oee >= 85, "low", oee >= 70, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=oee low=85-100 elevated=70-85 severe=0-70

index=demo_infra sensor_type=temperature | stats avg(value_celsius) as temp | eval temp=round(temp, 1) | eval range=case(temp <= 22, "low", temp <= 25, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=temp low=0-22 elevated=22-25 severe=25-50

index=demo_mssql event_type=performance | stats avg(buffer_cache_hit_ratio) as cache | eval cache=round(cache, 1) | eval range=case(cache >= 95, "low", cache >= 90, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=cache low=95-100 elevated=90-95 severe=0-90
index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent | stats avg(metric_name:network.latency) as latency | eval latency=round(latency * 1000, 0)

index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=http-server | stats avg(metric_name:http.server.request.availability) as avail | eval avail=round(avail, 1) | eval range=case(avail >= 99, "low", avail >= 95, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avail low=99-100 elevated=95-99 severe=0-95

index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=api | stats avg(metric_name:api.completion) as compl | eval compl=round(compl, 1) | eval range=case(compl >= 99, "low", compl >= 90, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=compl low=99-100 elevated=90-99 severe=0-90
index=demo_cisco_catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:devicehealth" | stats avg(HealthScore) as health | eval health=round(health, 1)
index=demo_cisco_catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:devicehealth" | stats latest(Reachability) as reachability by DeviceName | stats count(eval(reachability!="Reachable")) as unreachable
index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent | stats avg(metric_name:network.loss) as loss | eval loss=round(loss, 2)
index=demo_thousendeyes "thousandeyes.test.name"="AI Support Assistant API" | stats avg(metric_name:api.duration) as duration | eval duration=round(duration, 1)

index=demo_ai_defense sourcetype="cisco:ai:defense" | stats count(eval(event_message_type="prompt" AND event_action="Allow")) as prompts count(eval(event_message_type="response")) as responses | eval unanswered=if(prompts > 0, round(100 * (prompts - responses) / prompts, 1), 0) | fields unanswered
index=demo_msteams event_type=call_queue_stats queue_name="Support Hotline" | stats latest(calls_waiting) as waiting
index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:erp:performance" dialog_response_time_ms=* | stats avg(dialog_response_time_ms) as response | eval response=round(response, 0)
index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:erp:performance" hana_memory_used_pct=* | stats latest(hana_memory_used_pct) as memory

index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:idoc:status" | stats sum(idocs_created) as created sum(idocs_delivered) as delivered | eval delivered_pct=if(created > 0, min(100, round(100 * delivered / created, 1)), 100) | fields delivered_pct
index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:idoc" direction=outbound status="02" | stats count
index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:idoc:status" | stats latest(idoc_outbound_backlog) as backlog by partner | stats sum(backlog) as backlog
index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:mii:performance" | stats latest(mii_order_buffer) as buffer by location | stats min(buffer) as buffer

div.div: Executive Overview
High-level KPIs and system health across all locations
Manufacturing
Production lines, OEE, quality metrics, and inventory tracking
SAP ERP & MII
ERP PRD, HANA, production order IDocs to the SAP MII of every plant
Datacenter Infrastructure
Environmental monitoring, power, cooling, and UPS systems
Server Infrastructure
VMware VMs, ESXi hosts, and Windows Server monitoring
Database Performance
SQL Server metrics, query analysis, and transaction logs
AI Workload Infrastructure
AI Support Bot end to end: DC Frankfurt path, Cisco AI Defense, GPUs, Support Hotline
Network & Collaboration
ThousandEyes network monitoring and Microsoft Teams analytics
Cisco Catalyst Center
Campus device health, reachability and security advisories
Switch Syslog & Telemetry
IOS XE syslog, CLI audit and gNMI interface telemetry of the campus switches
Cisco Meraki
Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, device availability and assurance alerts
Network Intelligence
Catalyst Center and Meraki across all sites in one view
ThousandEyes
DC paths, BGP, SaaS, web transactions and internal APIs
Tomcat Webserver
Web traffic, error rates, DOS detection for Atlanta, Berlin, and Vienna web servers

search.query: | union [| search index=demo_mes production_rate_per_hour=* | stats avg(oee_pct) as oee by location | eval oee=round(oee, 1)] [| search index=demo_infra sensor_type=temperature | stats avg(value_celsius) as temp by location | eval temp=round(temp, 1)] [| search index=demo_infra sensor_type=power sensor_id=*-power-total | stats avg(value_kw) as power by location | eval power=round(power, 0)] [| search index=demo_mssql event_type=performance | eval db_host=mvindex(host, 0) | stats avg(buffer_cache_hit_ratio) as db_cache by location | eval db_cache=round(db_cache, 1)] [| search index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=http-server | stats avg(metric_name:http.server.request.availability) as web_avail by thousandeyes.agent.location | rename thousandeyes.agent.location as location | eval web_avail=round(web_avail, 1)] [| search index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=api | stats avg(metric_name:api.completion) as api_compl by thousandeyes.agent.location | rename thousandeyes.agent.location as location | eval api_compl=round(api_compl, 1)] [| search index=demo_cisco_catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:devicehealth" earliest=-5m | rex field=Location "(?i)(?<location>vienna|berlin|atlanta)" | eval location=lower(location) | stats avg(HealthScore) as campus by location | eval campus=round(campus, 1)] [| search index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent earliest=-5m | stats avg(metric_name:network.loss) as dc_loss by thousandeyes.agent.location | rename thousandeyes.agent.location as location | eval dc_loss=round(dc_loss, 2)] [| search index=demo_cisco_meraki sourcetype="meraki:wirelessdevicespacketlossbydevice" earliest=-5m | rex field=network.name "(?i)^(?<location>vienna|berlin|atlanta)" | eval location=lower(location) | stats avg(downstream.lossPercentage) as wifi_loss by location | eval wifi_loss=round(wifi_loss, 1)] [| search index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:mii:performance" earliest=-5m | stats latest(mii_order_buffer) as mii_buffer by location] | stats first(mii_buffer) as "MII Buffer", first(oee) as "OEE %", first(temp) as "Temp (degC)", first(power) as "Power (kW)", first(db_cache) as "DB Cache %", first(web_avail) as "Web Avail %", first(api_compl) as "API Compl %", first(campus) as "Campus Health", first(dc_loss) as "DC Loss %", first(wifi_loss) as "Wi-Fi Loss %" by location | eval mii_ok=coalesce('MII Buffer', 24) | eval Status=case( 'OEE %' >= 85 AND 'Temp (degC)' <= 25 AND 'DB Cache %' >= 90 AND 'Web Avail %' >= 99 AND 'API Compl %' >= 99 AND 'Campus Health' >= 8 AND 'DC Loss %' <= 0.5 AND 'Wi-Fi Loss %' <= 2 AND mii_ok >= 15, "[OK] Optimal", 'OEE %' >= 70 AND 'Temp (degC)' <= 28 AND 'DB Cache %' >= 80 AND 'Web Avail %' >= 90 AND 'API Compl %' >= 80 AND 'Campus Health' >= 5 AND 'DC Loss %' <= 2 AND 'Wi-Fi Loss %' <= 5 AND mii_ok >= 5, "[WARN] Warning", 1=1, "[ERR] Critical" ) | rename location as Location | table Location Status "MII Buffer" "Campus Health" "DC Loss %" "Wi-Fi Loss %" "OEE %" "Temp (degC)" "Power (kW)" "DB Cache %" "Web Avail %" "API Compl %" | sort Location

| union [| search index=demo_mes | eval system="Manufacturing" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_infra | eval system="Infrastructure" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_mssql | eval system="Database" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_windows_events | eval system="Windows" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_msteams | eval system="Teams" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_thousendeyes | eval system="Network (ThousandEyes)" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_tomcat_logs | eval system="Web Servers (Tomcat)" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_cisco_catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:*" | eval system="Cisco Catalyst Center" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_cisco_catalyst sourcetype IN ("cisco:ios", "cisco:gnmi") | eval system="Switch Syslog & gNMI" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_cisco_meraki | eval system="Cisco Meraki" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_cisco_apps | eval system="Cisco Apps" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_ai_defense | eval system="Cisco AI Defense" | stats count as events by system] [| search index=demo_sap | eval system="SAP ERP & MII" | stats count as events by system] [| mstats count(_value) as events WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_name=* | eval system="VMware & GPU Metrics"] [| mstats count(_value) as events WHERE index=demo_windows_metrics metric_name=* | eval system="Windows Metrics"] | eval events=tostring(events, "commas") | sort -events | rename system as "System", events as "Events"

| union [| search index=demo_mes event_type=alarm severity=critical OR severity=error | eval issue_type="Manufacturing Alarm" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_mssql event_type=alert severity=critical | eval issue_type="Database Alert" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_windows_events EventType=Error | eval issue_type="Windows Error", severity="error" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_msteams severity=high | eval issue_type="Teams Issue" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=api metric_name:api.completion<50 | eval issue_type="API Endpoint Degraded", severity="critical" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_tomcat_logs status>=400 | eval is_dos=if(match(useragent, "masscan|Go-http-client|libwww-perl"), 1, 0) | where is_dos=1 | eval issue_type="[DOS] Web Attack", severity="critical" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_cisco_catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:devicehealth" Reachability!="Reachable" | eval issue_type="Network Device Unreachable", severity="critical" | stats dc(DeviceName) as count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent metric_name:network.loss>=2 | eval issue_type="Network Path Loss (ThousandEyes)", severity="high" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_ai_defense sourcetype="cisco:ai:defense" event_action="Block" | eval issue_type="AI Defense Blocked Prompt", severity="warning" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_msteams event_type=call_queue_stats queue_name="Support Hotline" calls_waiting>12 | eval issue_type="Support Hotline Overloaded", severity="high" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:idoc" direction=outbound status="02" | eval issue_type="SAP IDoc Error (ERP to MII)", severity="critical" | stats count by issue_type severity] [| search index=demo_mes event_type=system_alert alert_type=order_data_missing | eval issue_type="Production Waiting for SAP Orders", severity="critical" | stats dc(location) as count by issue_type severity] | sort -count | rename issue_type as "Issue Type", severity as "Severity", count as "Count"
